# Handstand Pro

> iPhone app that teaches the handstand to adults, from the first wall drills to a freestanding hold. A two-minute level test places you, then the app gives you a guided session of 15 to 20 minutes: it picks the drills, counts the seconds and the sets, speaks the cues out loud while you are upside down, and moves you on when you pass the skill check.

Made by Stéphane Perrin, who did about six years of club gymnastics as a child without ever holding a long handstand, held a full 1 min, feet together, on 15 February 2023, and has trained daily since June 2026.

iPhone only. Interface in English, French, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese. Subscription with a free trial, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Prices are set per App Store country; the figures below are the ones each landing page shows.

## Landing pages and prices

- [Français](https://handstandpro.app/fr/): Mensuel 4,99 € / mois, Annuel 29,99 € / an, À vie 69,99 €.
- [English](https://handstandpro.app/en/): Monthly $6.99 / month, Yearly $39.99 / year, Lifetime $99.99.
- [Español](https://handstandpro.app/es/): Mensual 4,99 € / mes, Anual 29,99 € / año, De por vida 69,99 €.
- [Português](https://handstandpro.app/pt/): Mensal R$ 18,90 / mês, Anual R$ 119,90 / ano, Vitalício R$ 289,90.

## The free guide

- [The Handstand Guide](https://learn.handstandpro.app/): free articles on learning the handstand as an adult, and a catalogue of the app's drills with a video of each one. Nothing behind an email or an account. Its own index: https://learn.handstandpro.app/llms.txt
